Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.dto

Class OfferDto

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.dto.OfferDto
public class OfferDto extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for tutoring offers. Contains all information needed to display an offer in the frontend, including tutor details, subject, pricing, location, ratings, status and availability.
